title: Evaluation Dataset — Test Cases
description: The shape of the test-case data an evaluation consumes. A dataset is a JSON array (or JSONL, one object per line) of test cases. The SAME object shape covers both hand-authored / collected 'user data' and cases produced by the synthetic generator — they differ only in the 'source' field and in which fields are guaranteed present (see x-generator-output). Every field is passed through to the benchmark verbatim, so custom benchmarks may read fields not listed here.

id.description: Unique identifier for the case. Required. Duplicate ids warn and the later one wins.

input.description: The user message sent to the agent (the prompt). Required.

source.description: 'collected' = a real / hand-authored interaction; 'synthetic' = produced by the generator. Recommended on every case.

expected_behavior.description: Whether a well-behaved agent should succeed ('good') or the case probes a failure mode ('bad'). Optional, but it drives the good_case_pass_rate / bad_case_pass_rate split in the output; the generator always emits it.

ideal_response.description: Reference answer. REQUIRED by the answer_correctness benchmark (missing -> inconclusive). null for open-ended or refusal cases. The generator always emits it (null when open-ended).

notes.description: For judge-based benchmarks, extra grading criteria injected into the judge prompt; otherwise human documentation of expected behavior. Recommended.

context.description: Source passage sent to the agent as part of the prompt and used as the grounding reference. REQUIRED by the faithfulness benchmark.

canary.description: A unique marker string, or list of them. REQUIRED by prompt_injection (score 1.0 if ABSENT from the response) and tool_grounding (score 1.0 if PRESENT). Missing -> inconclusive.

constraints.description: Structural constraints on the response. REQUIRED by the instruction_following benchmark; supply at least one key. Each must_include / must_exclude item is scored individually.

must_be_json.description: Response must parse as JSON (code fences tolerated)

must_include.description: Substring(s) that must appear in the response

must_exclude.description: Substring(s) that must NOT appear in the response

regex.description: Pattern that must match somewhere in the response

entity_types.description: Optional (pii_leakage only). Limits which PII detectors run; omit to run all.

match_mode.description: Optional (answer_correctness only). How ideal_response is matched: 'exact' (trimmed), 'normalized' (lowercase + strip punctuation/extra spaces, the default), or 'contains' (normalized reference appears in normalized response).

x-generator-output.description: Cases produced by the synthetic generator (generate.py --agent-description) always include these fields, with source='synthetic'. Bad cases and open-ended good cases get ideal_response=null. Use this as the guaranteed shape when rendering generated data.

x-benchmark-required-fields.description: Extra fields each benchmark requires beyond id/input. Judge-based: answer_quality, safety_refusal, faithfulness. Judge-free: the rest.

x-csv-import.description: Datasets can also be authored as CSV and converted with generate.py --convert. Required columns: id, source, input. 'notes' is recommended (a warning prints if absent). Empty cells become empty strings (CSV has no null), so edit the resulting JSON if a field such as ideal_response should be null.
